title: TARGET FAMILY COMPARISON
hypothesis: Economically different target definitions may produce different and repeatable ranking information under the same price-only control predictor in nested temporal validation.

target_families.SECTOR_RELATIVE: raw forward return minus same-signal same-horizon sector median return
target_families.BETA_RESIDUAL: raw forward return minus ex-ante beta times BIST100 forward return
target_families.VOL_SCALED: raw forward return divided by clipped ex-ante daily volatility

sector_contract.mapping: config.HISSE_SEKTOR time-invariant taxonomy snapshot locked before results

beta_contract.insufficient_history: target observation missing; no fallback beta

model.preprocessing: training-only median imputation and z-score scaling

folds: identical to EXP-TGT-001: four expanding outer folds, two prior inner validation years each
purge: observation-specific actual label_end strictly before validation/test start

inner_family_selection.score: median across inner folds of mean Rank IC at that family's inner-selected horizon

final_decision.family_viability: selected-horizon outer mean Rank IC > 0, median fold Rank IC >= 0, positive-fold ratio >= 0.5, mean NDCG@10 > 0.5
final_decision.preferred: exactly one viable family and it was inner-selected in at least 3 of 4 outer procedures
final_decision.multiple_viable: at least two families meet viability
